# bioexcel/biobb_vs/box

## Summary

This class sets the center and the size of a rectangular parallelepiped box around a set of residues or a pocket.

Sets the center and the size of a rectangular parallelepiped box around a set of residues from a given PDB or a pocket from a given PQR.

Nextflow adapter of the [Box](https://biobb-vs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/utils.html#module-utils.box) building block of [biobb_vs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_vs) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_VS_BOX } from 'bioexcel/biobb_vs/box'

workflow {
    BIOBB_VS_BOX(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb, pqr | PDB file containing a selection of residue numbers or PQR file containing the pocket |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | PDB including the annotation of the box center and size as REMARKs |
| `versions_biobb_vs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_vs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Box properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_pdb_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_vs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_VS_BOX' {
        ext.properties = [offset: 2.0]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `offset` | number | 2.0 | Extra distance (Angstroms) between the last residue atom and the box boundary. |
| `box_coordinates` | boolean | false | Add box coordinates as 8 ATOM records. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
